baseline.source: screener.compute_confluence_score + decision.make_decision over screener.fetch_market (Bybit-first USDT aggregate, not venue-pinned)

cvd_1h.method: estimated from 1h candle shape (screener.compute_cvd), not trades

predicted.note: live estimate for the current period; changes until it settles

trend_last_settlements.method: mean of last 3 vs first 3 settlements, ±10% of max |rate| = flat

htf_bias.source: htf_bias.compute_htf_bias (60/240/D) over screener.fetch_market (Bybit-first USDT aggregate, not venue-pinned)

indicators.source: analyst.py from the same closed candles

liquidity.source: liquidity.build_liquidity_map over screener.fetch_market (Bybit-first USDT aggregate, not venue-pinned)

caveats: liquidations are a LOWER BOUND: only the time the collector was connected is counted and Binance pushes at most one liquidation per symbol per second
whales = Hyperliquid top-N accounts by account value; they include vaults and market makers, so their net side is not pure directional conviction
ratios are completed-period venue data and can lag one period

liquidations.label: Bybit allLiquidation pushes all liquidations (500 ms batches); notional uses the bankruptcy price; only connected time is covered, so totals are a lower bound.
